classified.result: Canonical prefix is homogeneous, but no primary network-wide direct tariff was found. Public station-level observations vary by connector/site (examples observed: AC 0.66 EUR/kWh plus 0.03 EUR/min after 240 minutes; DC 0.89 EUR/kWh at selected DE*HOM EVSEs), while other public stations expose ad-hoc payment with the direct price unknown. These values are discovery/station evidence only and are not promoted prefix-wide. Resolve exact AFIR/Mobilithek/DATEX-II or direct-payment price per EVSE; unknown points remain unpriced.

Canonical prefix is homogeneous and AFIR/Mobilithek-derived public records expose exact ad-hoc prices on individual DE*EAD EVSEs, but observed values differ by station/connector. No primary universal EA-DD tariff was found, so only verified station-level values may be attached; unresolved EVSEs remain fail-closed.

The official company site confirms EV charging as part of its managed micro-grid/Energy-as-a-Service portfolio but publishes no driver-facing charging tariff, station price map, public QR/payment endpoint or tariff sheet. No exact station-level price was found from a primary or AFIR/Mobilithek source during this pass. Keep all DE*IPG EVSEs visible but unpriced until a reproducible direct-payment payload, official tariff, or AFIR station price becomes available.
